deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It holds two kinds of non-mathematical notes.

(1) Under the heading 'Geschäftsordnung' (rules of procedure) is a procedural rule for university or faculty business conducted by circulating a written 'Missiv' among voting members. In paraphrase: if, while a Missiv is circulating, one voter (Votant) proposes a new matter, and one or more later voters (Postopinanten) have already commented on it favourably or unfavourably, those comments count only as provisional. To take effect, such a proposal must be circulated again, completely, from the beginning. This fits Gauss's role as a Göttingen professor taking part in collegial votes by circular.

(2) Below is a reading or library list, apparently written in 1838 (the '1838' added above the British Association entry seems to date the list or the borrowing):
- Robert Walsh, 'A Residence at Constantinople during a period including the commencement, progress and termination of the Greek and Turkish revolutions', London 1836, 2 vols.
- Gustav Nieritz, 'Der Abenteurer wider Willen. Eine Erzählung aus unsrer ereignissreichen Zeit', 2 parts, Königsberg in der Neumark 1837, octavo. A price of 2¾ (thaler?) is noted.
- Report of the 6th Meeting of the British Association for the Advancement of Science, held at Bristol in August 1836, London 1837.
- Neuer Nekrolog der Deutschen for 1836, Weimar 1838.
- Gustav Nicolai, 'Italien wie es wirklich ist', parts 1–2, Leipzig 1835.
- K. A. Varnhagen von Ense, 'Denkwürdigkeiten und vermischte Schriften', vols 3–4, Mannheim 1838.
- F. K. von Strombeck, 'Darstellungen aus meinem Leben und aus meiner Zeit', part 6, Braunschweig 1838.

No computation, derivation or mathematical claim appears. The neighbouring pages' mathematics (a series summing to π/4 on p.83; the mean error of vernier readings on the next page) is not on this folio.

results.what: Procedural rule: proposals raised during the circulation of a Missiv must be recirculated from the start before they take effect
Bibliographic reading/borrowing list of 1836–1838 publications (travel, memoirs, fiction, British Association report)

deep.surprise_reason: The page has no mathematical content. It holds only an administrative procedural note and a list of books, which is of minor biographical interest regarding Gauss's reading around 1838.
transcription_corrections: Line 2: 'Gegenstand' appears to carry an interlinear insertion (possibly 'und') above it; the struck-through word at the start of line 3 ('u.s.w.') is cancelled.
'Eine Erzählung aus unserer' should read 'aus unsrer' (as written in the image).
The price '(2¾ M.)' is more likely '(2¾ Rthl.)' — the currency sign resembles a Reichsthaler abbreviation, not 'M.'.
'v. Strombeck Darstellungen aus m. Leben u. aus meiner Zeit' – 'm.' = 'meinem'; the author is Friedrich Karl von Strombeck.
'Constantinopel' is spelled 'Constantinopel' in the hand (German spelling); the English title proper is 'A Residence at Constantinople'.
